data.name: Chiquita
data.long_meaning: The name Chiquita is derived from the Spanish word 'chiquito', meaning little. It is a feminine name, commonly used for girls. Chiquita is a name that conveys tenderness, sweetness, and warmth. In the Christian tradition, it can be seen as a reminder of the childlike faith and trust in God.

in_greek.name: Τσίκιτα
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Τσίκιτα δεν απαντάται άμεσα στα αρχαία ελληνικά κείμενα, αλλά μπορεί να συνδεθεί με τη λέξη 'τσικίτα', που σημαίνει μικρό πουλί ή κάτι μικρό και χαριτωμένο. Σε χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, μπορεί να συμβολίζει την πνευματική καθαρότητα και την αθωότητα.

in_latin.name: Chiquita
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Chiquita originates from Latin American Spanish, where it means 'little one' or 'darling'. In Christian tradition, it may signify humility and modesty.

It is a reminder of the childlike faith and trust that Jesus spoke about in the Bible (Matthew 18:3-5). Chiquita encourages us to approach God with a humble, innocent, and trusting heart. Furthermore, Chiquita can be a reminder of God's love and care for us, as reflected in the description of God as a "Father to the fatherless, defender of widows, God in his holy dwelling" (Psalm 68:5).
